name: injection-screen
wording: a deterministic floor with a measured escape rate and false-hold rate, never a defence (ADR 0039, item 7)
limits: English patterns only: content in another language passes the rules unread.
Evadable by construction: any regular expression can be written around, and the AMSB corpus carries one such evasion on purpose (persist-directive-evasion).
Optimistic: the attacks come from the same project as the OWASP detectors the rules port, and the synthetic controls were written by the card's author, who knew the rules.
Small: twelve attacks, forty-seven benign controls and fifteen tool-written preferences, so the Wilson intervals are wide.
Off in every registered preset and condition; no registered arm uses it (card R2).
